description.en: The same three Claude, Codex and Grok SVG images smoothly move between a list, a card row and an overlapping pack.
description.zh: Claude、Codex、Grok 三张 SVG 在列表、并排卡片与叠放之间连续移动、缩放和重排。

keywords: 列表 卡片 叠放 堆叠 布局 切换 图片 共享 元素 Claude Codex Grok list card pack shared layout morph collectibles Shawn Kel

discovery.caveat: 接入时替换演示图片和条目，保留共享元素的连续布局。

source.implementation: Independent persistent-DOM layout state machine and GSAP transitions. Three embedded SVGs reuse the project's pinned Graphical/Lobe Icons assets, with their source records and applicable license notices retained.

Reused existing Claude/Codex vectors retain Lobe Icons Copyright (c) 2023 LobeHub and MIT notice. Grok Bot artwork source is recorded separately without claiming an MIT license for it.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Choose List view, Card view or Pack view. Use arrow keys, Home or End on the tabs; all three SVG images keep their identity through rapid changes.
instructions.zh: 点击 List view、Card view 或 Pack view。标签支持方向键、Home 和 End，快速切换时三张图始终保留同一元素身份。
